title: Syracuse chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion
summary: Expanded the Syracuse Peace Council seed into eight current organizations/programs and five public people, with explicit coalition, committee, program, affiliate, joint-organizing and public-role relations.

provenance.method: bounded current public-web organization/person expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Preserve distinct legal and organizational identities even when organizations share committees, personnel or branding.
Explicit public roles are recorded as public-role relations with provenance.
Historical names such as Peace Action of Central New York are preserved as status context rather than silently treated as separate current organizations.
data.method: Re-verify Syracuse Peace Council as seed, follow current first-party coalition/program/committee edges, deduplicate against repository, then cross-enumerate public organization roles and national affiliates.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which current public organizations, programs, affiliates and public-facing people are directly connected to the Syracuse Peace Council seed?

findings.finding: Syracuse Peace Council and CNY Solidarity Coalition mutually identify an active coalition relationship; Urban Jobs Task Force is also explicitly linked in the Syracuse coalition graph.
Neighbors of the Onondaga Nation is explicitly a Syracuse Peace Council program; Nuclear Free World is an SPC committee and explicitly an affiliate of Peace Action.
Beyond War and Militarism is explicitly a joint committee of Syracuse Peace Council and CNY Solidarity Coalition.
Indivisible Onondaga County is current in 2026, affiliated with the national Indivisible movement, and publicly identifies steering-committee members Tom Keck and Judy Jerome.
